subject: general
question:
The given graph provides the details of the price of petrol (in rupees) per litre in 4 months in Delhi. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/927f99995da2fe8c121629fe23fc6f24b91db0411ec4a186071da3c6c5d5127c.png] ​

Find the approximate percentage increase of the rate of petrol from January to April
solution:
**Given:**

The price of petrol in January = ₹90 per litre

The price of petrol in April = ₹105 per litre

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = ((New price - Old price) / Old price) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Percentage increase = ((105 - 90) / 90) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = (15 / 90) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = 16.67% ≈ 17%

**∴ The approximate percentage increase in the rate of petrol from January to April is 17%.**
